lines.en: I walk carrying glass jars
My robe sweeps the grass
I walk slowly along the flowers
I raise a hand against the sun
My pocket holds paper pins
I go around a poppy patch
I stop to check my net
I take the dirt path by the trees
My shoes are dusted with pollen
I jot something down as I walk
I come out from the village
I head for the flower field
I spread a sheet of mounting paper
I hold a jar up to my eye
I count the butterflies in the jars
I wait for the sun to climb
I rest the net handle on my shoulder
I look down and write a note
I lift my eyes to the flowers
I tap the jar glass gently
My fingers are dusted with scales
I tug my belt straight
I study wing patterns through glass
I press the lid down tight
I smooth the corner of a sheet
Have you come to trade specimens
I take butterflies here
Did you bring a net

lines.zh: 我认得一个鳞翅目学家
lines.en: I know a lepidopterist
You want to trade with me
Let me see your catch
You have no scale dust on you
My trade is an interesting one
Have you any bottled butterflies
I sell nothing else here
Which woods did you come from
This jar of mine is empty
Tell me what you brought
No rush, I will look it over
Your hands are quite clean
I am waiting for a new species
Would you like to see my notes
I step back to guard the jars
My sheets scatter
My glasses are knocked askew
That startled me badly
I crouch to gather my things
My net handle has split
One jar has broken
I even lost my hat
The specimens are what hurt
Put the bread away
I care only for wings
That will not buy a butterfly
I want specimens, not a meal
You have brought the wrong thing
This I will not take
Take the food away
This does not go in my jars
It does not even smell of flowers
You knocked my jars
I clutch the jars to steady them
My sheets flutter to the ground
You stepped on my net
I crouch to gather the sheets
We scatter my things
I hurry to fix my hat
You frightened one away
I wave you to slow down
That has cost me something
I spend my years chasing butterflies

lines.zh: 我的同类都在别的村子
lines.en: My colleagues are in other villages
I cannot say much about that
I would rather sort my specimens
Too few butterflies this season
My notes are not finished
You have changed the subject
Let me set these jars down first

lines.zh: 我更愿意一个人走花田
lines.en: I prefer the flower field alone

lines.zh: 这些事等蝶季过了再说
lines.en: We will talk when the season ends
I lift a single wing carefully
It has dried right through
I slip it between the sheets
I pick up a fallen stopper
My net caught something
I spread it on the table
This one is still usable
I fold the paper corner over
I put my notes away
This one needs its own jar
What have you to show me
I see your hands moving
Did you catch something
Bring the jar here
I want a close look at it
I have not seen this species
Do not open the lid yet
Let me find paper and pins
This deserves a fine sheet
I adjust my glasses
These wing markings are strange
Move the light a little
I will put it in a jar
One moment, hold still
I am getting the paper ready
I keep my eyes on your jar
That one is about to fly off
I wait for you to steady it
My net is up
You come around from the left
Let me block the light first
I count its wing veins
I must draw these markings
Do not shake the jar
I shift my angle a little
This one is unusually fine
I lay the mounting sheet flat
I reach out slowly
Loosen the lid for me
I can see its antennae now
This one must be set while fresh
I count its spots
I bring the lamp closer
I sweep the net down
My fingers pinch the wings
I cap it with the jar
That sweep missed
I block with my hand
Wings brush my face
I press the paper down fast
I trap it against the table
I do not mean to hurt it
I nudge it with a fingertip
That catch came up empty too
I step back and aim again
I switch the net to my left hand
Do not frighten it off
I hold my breath and reach
This time I have it
I walk into the village with a net
My stall stands by the flower field
I set the jars out on the table
I straighten my robe
I come back from the woods
Dew still clings to my hat brim
I spread the mounting paper out
I stop at the village edge
I stand the net by my feet

lines.zh: 阳光照到我的玻璃瓶上
lines.en: Sunlight finds my glass jars
I check today's catch
I take my place at the flower field

lines.zh: 有人从林子里带东西来
lines.en: Someone is bringing something from the woods
I open my notebook

lines.zh: 我的摊子上多了一只瓶
lines.en: A new jar joins my stall
I raise a hand to a visitor
I count today's species
I am ready to begin
Fire blackens a stack of sheets
I land and crush my specimens
Water soaks my notes
The blast breaks every jar
An arrow passes through my net
Magic smears my scale dust
A whole day without food, my hands shake

lines.zh: 雷击把我手里的瓶打裂
lines.en: The strike cracks the jar in my hand
I fall still clutching my specimens
